verdict.rationale: Zep's Graphiti-based Context Graph explicitly implements a bi-temporal model with fact invalidation, tracking how facts change over time and maintaining provenance (zep-docs-43, zep-gh-1, zep-gh-2). This directly supports distinguishing current vs outdated facts for ml-engineers building agent memory. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent benchmark validating temporal accuracy in production, and docs don't detail query-time filtering by validity window in depth.
